name: Urausu (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Urausu town emblem in white: a ring open at the bottom beneath a stylised letter A.
history: Municipal flag of Urausu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 9 May 1968.

features.role: Urausu town emblem — a ring open at the bottom beneath a stylised letter A
